DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居に関するご相談でしょうか。こちらの申込案内を一緒に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about moving? We can check these application instructions together.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越し後も旧住所へ届く手紙があるので、転送の申込みをしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所に届く手紙の転送申込みを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Some letters still arrive at my old address after my move, so I would like to apply for mail forwarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request to apply for forwarding of letters arriving at your old address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 旧住所と新住所、転居する方の情報を確認しましょう。記入した用紙はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check your old and new addresses and the details of the people moving. Have you filled in a form?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 途中まで書きましたが、旧住所の部屋番号を間違えたかもしれません。ここは提出前に直せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記入済み旧住所の部屋番号に不安があり修正を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I filled it in partway, but I may have got the room number at the old address wrong. Can I correct it here before submitting?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you are unsure about the old-address room number you entered and ask about correcting it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ提出前ですので、正しい情報を確かめてください。わからないまま記入するのは避けましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You have not submitted it yet, so please confirm the correct information. Avoid filling it in while unsure.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前の契約書をスマートフォンで確認できます。部屋番号を確かめてから書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約書で部屋番号を確認して書き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can check my previous rental contract on my smartphone. I will confirm the room number before rewriting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the room number in your contract and rewrite it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できたら受付へお持ちください。本人確認の書類についても、この案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Once confirmed, please bring it to reception. Please also check these instructions about identity documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族も一緒に引っ越しましたが、私だけ先に出してよいか、手続きの説明をお願いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族と同居転居し自分だけ先に申込む場合の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My family moved with me, but could you explain the procedure if I apply for myself first?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your family moved together with you and ask about applying for yourself first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人分とご家族分の申込みについて、現在の案内に沿って説明します。対象の方を先に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain applications for you and your family according to the current instructions. First, let us confirm who is included.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私と妻の二人です。二人分の扱いを聞いて、必要な情報をそろえてから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象は自分と妻と伝え必要情報をそろえてから提出すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: The two of us, my wife and me. I will ask how both of us are handled and gather the necessary information before submitting.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the people included are you and your wife, and decide to gather the necessary information before submitting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご案内は以上です。用紙を整えたらまたお越しください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-FUKUYAMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. That concludes the explanation. Please come back once you have completed the form. Take care.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。御朱印の受付はこちらですが、先にご参拝はお済みですか。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. This is the reception for shrine seal inscriptions, but have you paid your respects first?

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。先にお参りしたいので、拝殿への行き方を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未参拝であることを伝えて拝殿への道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I would like to pray first, so could you tell me how to get to the worship hall?
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have not prayed yet and ask the way to the worship hall. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通路の先です。石段が濡れていますので、手すり側をお通りください。御朱印は参拝後に承ります。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is at the end of this passage. The stone steps are wet, so please use the side by the handrail. We accept shrine-seal requests after your visit to pray.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。お参りしてから戻ります。御朱印帳は今ここに預けるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参拝後に戻ることを伝えて御朱印帳を預ける時点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I will return after praying. Should I leave my shrine-seal book here now?
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will return after praying and ask when to leave your shrine-seal book. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お戻りになってからで結構です。…お帰りなさい。ご希望のページを開いてお渡しください。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: After you return is fine. ...Welcome back. Please open your book to the page you want and hand it to us.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お参りを済ませました。こちらの空いているページにお願いします。裏に墨が移らないか気になります。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 参拝済みと希望ページを伝え墨移りへの懸念を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have finished praying. Please use this blank page. I am concerned whether the ink might transfer to the reverse side.
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have prayed, indicate your preferred page, and ask about your concern over ink transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 間に紙を挟んでお返しします。今はほかのお預かりもあるので、出来上がりまで十五分ほどです。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will return it with paper between the pages. We have other books at the moment, so it will take about fifteen minutes.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それではお願いします。待つ間に境内を歩いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付を依頼し待ち時間の境内散策の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then please go ahead. May I walk around the shrine grounds while waiting?
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the service and ask whether you may walk around the grounds while waiting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらの引換札をお持ちください。建物の裏は作業中ですので、お入りにならないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please keep this claim tag. Work is in progress behind the building, so please do not enter that area.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 作業中の場所には入りません。この札を持って、十五分後を目安に戻ります。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 立入禁止を守り引換札を持って十五分後に戻ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not enter the area where work is in progress. I will keep this tag and return in about fifteen minutes.
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you will respect the restricted area, keep the claim tag, and return in fifteen minutes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。札の番号でお呼びしますので、こちらでお受け取りください。それでは、足元にお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will call your tag number, so please collect it here. Watch your step.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お土産をお探しですか。配るご予定なら、人数から箱の大きさをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Are you looking for souvenirs? If you plan to give them out, I can suggest a box size based on the number of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 明日、職場の十二人に配ります。二千円以内で、一人ずつ渡せるものが欲しいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 十二人に明日配る個別配布用菓子を二千円以内で希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: I will give them to twelve people at work tomorrow. I want something I can give to each person individually, within 2,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Request individually distributable sweets for twelve coworkers tomorrow, within 2,000 yen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらの十二個入りは千八百円です。隣は十個入りで千五百円ですが、二箱だとご予算を超えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: This box of twelve is 1,800 yen. The one beside it has ten for 1,500 yen, but two boxes would exceed your budget.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 十二個入りを見せてください。中のお菓子は全部、別々に包まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 十二個入りを選び個包装の有無を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Please show me the box of twelve. Are all the sweets inside individually wrapped?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose the box of twelve and check whether the sweets are individually wrapped. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、一個ずつ包装されています。ただ、外箱を開けると保存の注意書きは箱にしかありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, each piece is wrapped. However, after you open the outer box, the storage precautions are only written on the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 注意書きを写真に残しておきます。賞味期限は明日より後ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 注意書きを記録すると伝えて賞味期限を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: I will keep a photo of the precautions. Is the best-before date later than tomorrow?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will record the precautions and check the best-before date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この箱は来月十日までです。直射日光を避けて保管してください。持ち歩く時間は長いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: This box is good until the tenth of next month. Please store it away from direct sunlight. Will you carry it around for long?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: これから二時間ほど持ち歩きます。車には置かず、かばんに入れるつもりです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 持ち歩く時間と車内を避ける保管方法を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: I will carry it for about two hours from now. I plan to put it in my bag rather than leave it in the car.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain how long you will carry it and how you will store it while avoiding the car. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: つぶれないように持ち手のある袋にお入れします。こちらの一箱でよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: I will put it in a bag with handles to keep it from being crushed. Will this one box be all?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、その一箱にします。袋もお願いします。千八百円をカードで払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintJa: 一箱と袋を依頼し千八百円をカードで払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, I will take that one box. A bag too, please. I will pay the 1,800 yen by card.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Request one box and a bag and pay 1,800 yen by card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お支払いを確認しました。お菓子とレシートを袋に入れましたので、お持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-02-001-SHARED.translation: Your payment is confirmed. I have put the sweets and receipt in the bag, so please take it. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今の音、ここの丸のこから聞こえましたか。あなたはどこにいましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Did that sound come from this circular saw? Where were you?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 材料置き場にいました。切る音が途切れた後、金属がこすれるような音がしました。機械には触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 異音の発生状況と自分の位置を伝え機械に触れていないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: I was in the materials storage area. After the cutting sound stopped, I heard a metal-scraping noise. I have not touched the machine.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Report the circumstances of the unusual noise and your location, and say you have not touched the machine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 私が停止させました。確認が済むまで近寄らないでください。いつもと違う音がした時刻はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: I stopped it. Please stay away until the check is complete. Do you know what time the unusual noise occurred?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 時計で十時二十分ごろでした。刃の近くに木片が見えますが、拾わずにそのままにしていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 異音の時刻を示し木片を拾わず残す判断を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: It was around 10:20 by the clock. I can see a wood fragment near the blade; should I leave it there without picking it up?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Give the time of the unusual noise and confirm your decision to leave the wood fragment without picking it up. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: そのままにしてください。停止していても、木片を取るために手を入れてはいけません。私が電源の隔離も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Leave it there. Even when stopped, you must not put your hand in to remove wood fragments. I will also check isolation of the power supply.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 了解しました。私にはまだ操作の許可がないので、試しに動かすこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 操作権限がないため試運転もしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Understood. I do not yet have permission to operate it, so I will not even run it as a test.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will not even perform a test run because you lack operating authorization. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それでいいです。点検中はこの札を出します。ほかの人が使おうとしたら、点検中だと伝えて私を呼んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: That is right. We will display this tag during inspection. If someone tries to use it, tell them it is under inspection and call me.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 札が出ている間は使わないように伝えます。私は手作業の仕分けに戻っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 点検中の周知を引き受けて仕分け作業に戻る可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: I will tell them not to use it while the tag is displayed. May I return to sorting by hand?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Agree to notify others of the inspection and ask whether you may return to sorting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 戻ってください。ただし、機械側へ長い板を運ぶ作業は止めて、短い材料の仕分けだけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Please do. However, stop carrying long boards toward the machine and only sort short materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 短い材料だけを分けます。長い板の運搬は、点検が終わって指示をいただくまで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintJa: 短い材料だけを仕分けし長い板の運搬は指示まで待つと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: I will sort only the short materials. I will wait to carry long boards until the inspection is finished and I receive instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm you will sort only short materials and wait for instructions before carrying long boards. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お願いします。気づいた時点で知らせてくれて助かりました。では、また後で声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-03-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. It helped that you told us as soon as you noticed. I will speak to you again later.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: トマトをご覧ですか。値札が一枚落ちていましたね。どちらの商品の価格をお知りになりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Are you looking at the tomatoes? One price tag had fallen down. Which product's price would you like to know?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この袋入りのほうです。二百五十円の札は、隣のばら売りのトマトの値段でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 袋入り商品を示して二百五十円の値札の対象を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: The bagged ones here. Is the 250-yen tag for the loose tomatoes beside them?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Point to the bagged product and ask which item the 250-yen tag applies to. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 二百五十円はこの袋一つの値段です。ばら売りは一個百円で、札をこちらに戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: 250 yen is the price for one of these bags. The loose tomatoes are 100 yen each; I will put the tag back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 袋には三個入っているんですね。この端の一個は皮が割れていますが、同じ値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 三個入りと確認し皮の割れた一個がある袋の価格を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: So there are three in a bag. The skin on this one at the edge is split. Is the price the same?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm there are three and ask the price of the bag containing one tomato with split skin. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、その袋の値段は変わりません。傷のない別の袋もありますので、そちらをお選びいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, that bag's price is unchanged. We also have other bags without damaged tomatoes, so you can choose one of those.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今夜、生で食べたいので、傷のない袋を選びます。こちらの袋を買ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 生食する目的を伝え傷のない別の袋を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: I want to eat them raw tonight, so I will choose an undamaged bag. May I buy this one?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will eat them raw and choose another bag without damage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: どうぞ。そちらは三個とも傷が見当たりません。お会計は二百五十円です。ほかにお入り用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Of course. I do not see any damage on any of the three in that bag. That will be 250 yen. Do you need anything else?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日はトマトだけで結構です。小さな袋を持ってきたので、レジ袋はいりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 追加購入とレジ袋を断り持参袋を使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Just tomatoes today, thank you. I brought a small bag, so I do not need a shopping bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decline additional purchases and a shopping bag, saying you will use your own bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では、お持ちの袋に入れやすいよう、ここに置きます。お支払いをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Then I will place them here to make them easy to put in your bag. Please make your payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 五百円でお願いします。お釣りとレシートを受け取ってから、自分で袋に入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintJa: 五百円を渡し釣銭とレシートを受け取って自分で袋詰めする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Here is 500 yen. I will receive the change and receipt, then pack them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Hand over 500 yen, receive the change and receipt, and pack the items yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 二百五十円のお釣りとレシートです。トマトは上に載せるとつぶれにくいですよ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-04-001-SHARED.translation: Here are your 250 yen change and receipt. Putting the tomatoes on top helps keep them from being crushed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 次のショーをご覧になりますか。今は入口まで列が伸びています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Will you watch the next show? The line currently stretches to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 母が長く立っていられないので、ショーはやめて水槽を見たいです。座って休める場所もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 母の長時間立位の難しさを伝えショーを断り水槽と休憩場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: My mother cannot stand for long, so we would like to skip the show and see the tanks. Is there also somewhere to sit and rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain that your mother has difficulty standing for long, decline the show, and ask to see the tanks and find a resting place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この奥の休憩スペースに椅子があります。水槽の展示室は、その向かいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: There are chairs in the rest area farther inside. The tank exhibition room is opposite it.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 先に母を椅子で休ませます。展示室までは階段を使わずに行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 先に母を休ませると伝え階段を使わない経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: I will let my mother rest in a chair first. Can we reach the exhibition room without stairs?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will let your mother rest first and ask for a stair-free route. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、この階だけで見られます。上階の展示はエレベーターで行けますが、今は待つ方が多いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, you can view it on this floor. The exhibits upstairs are accessible by elevator, but many people are waiting now.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 今日はこの階だけにします。暗い展示室で、写真を撮るときにライトをつけてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 同階の見学を選び撮影時のライト使用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: We will stay on this floor today. In the dark exhibition room, may I turn on a light when taking photos?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Choose to view this floor and ask whether you may use a light for photography. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 撮影はできますが、フラッシュや撮影用ライトは消してください。動物を驚かせないためです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Photography is allowed, but please turn off flash and photographic lights to avoid startling the animals.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ライトを消して撮ります。休憩している母と別々にならないよう、出口の場所を先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: ライトを消すと伝え母とはぐれないよう出口の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: I will take photos with the light off. I would like to know where the exit is in advance so I do not get separated from my mother while she rests.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will turn the light off and ask where the exit is so you do not lose your mother. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 展示室の出口は休憩スペースの反対側です。中から来た道へ戻ることもできますので、無理に一周しなくても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: The exhibition-room exit is on the opposite side from the rest area. You can also return the way you came from inside, so there is no need to go all the way around.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: それなら母と一緒に入り、疲れたら同じ道で戻ります。休憩スペースから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintJa: 母と一緒に見学し疲れたら来た道を戻る計画を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Then I will enter with my mother and return the same way if she gets tired. We will start with the rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm your plan to visit with your mother and return the way you came if she gets tired. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、椅子は奥にございます。お二人のペースでご覧ください。それでは、ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-05-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, the chairs are farther inside. Please explore at your own pace together. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらは昔の農具を展示した部屋です。気になる道具はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: This room displays old farming tools. Are there any tools you are interested in?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 壁にある大きな櫛のような道具が気になります。何に使ったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 櫛状の道具を特定して用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I am interested in the tool on the wall that looks like a large comb. What was it used for?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Identify the comb-shaped tool and ask its purpose. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 稲の穂を間に通して、籾を外す千歯扱きです。実物は触れられませんが、使い方の絵が横にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: It is a senbakoki, a toothed threshing tool through which rice ears were pulled to remove the grains. You cannot touch the actual tool, but there is an illustration of its use beside it.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 絵を見ながら説明を聞きたいです。道具の名前を忘れそうなので、今のお話を録音してもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 絵を見ながら説明を聞き道具名の記録用に録音許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I would like to hear the explanation while looking at the picture. I might forget the tool's name, so may I record what you just explained?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you want to listen while looking at the picture and ask permission to record the explanation to remember the tool's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この部屋ではほかの方の声も入るため、録音はご遠慮いただいています。名前はこの紙に書けますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: We ask visitors not to record audio in this room because other people's voices would be recorded too. I can write the name on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 録音はやめます。「千歯扱き」の読み方も、紙に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 録音を取りやめ千歯扱きの読み方を書いてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I will not record it. Could you also write how to read '千歯扱き' on the paper?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Give up recording and ask to have the pronunciation of 千歯扱き written down. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 「せんばこき」です。こちらに書きました。この道具と解説札は写真に撮っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: It is 'senbakoki.' I have written it here. You may photograph this tool and its explanatory sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。写真にはほかの人が入らないようにします。窓の外にある小屋も展示ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 他人を写さない撮影方法を伝え窓外の小屋が展示か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you. I will make sure no other people appear in the photo. Is the hut outside the window an exhibit too?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will photograph without including other people and ask whether the hut outside the window is an exhibit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 外の小屋は収蔵庫なので入れません。公開しているのは、玄関でお渡しした図の色のついた建物です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: The outside hut is a storage building, so you cannot enter it. The buildings open to visitors are the colored ones on the map given to you at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 収蔵庫には入らず、図で公開されている建物だけを回ります。読み方を書いた紙も持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintJa: 収蔵庫への立入りを避け公開建物のみ見学し読み方の紙を持ち帰ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: I will not enter the storage building and will visit only the buildings shown as open on the map. I will take home the paper with the pronunciation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm you will avoid entering storage, visit only the public buildings, and take home the pronunciation note. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、次の建物にはかまどの展示があります。ご不明な点があればお声がけください。それでは、どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-06-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, the next building has a cooking-hearth exhibit. Please speak to us if anything is unclear. Enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 検査が一つ止まっていますね。どの部品のことで相談がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: One inspection has stopped, I see. Which part would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: この部品です。指示書の範囲は十・〇〇から十・〇五ミリですが、一回目は十・〇五、二回目は十・〇六でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 許容範囲と二回の異なる測定値を具体的に報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: This part. The specified range is 10.00 to 10.05 millimeters, but my first measurement was 10.05 and my second was 10.06.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Report the permitted range and the two different measurements specifically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 境界をまたいでいますね。測定面にごみがないか見て、決められた方法で測り直しましょう。測定器は何を使いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: The results cross the limit. Let us check the measuring surfaces for debris and measure again using the prescribed method. What measuring instrument did you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 指定のマイクロメーターです。私の判断で合格にせず、今は未判定の箱に置いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 指定測定器を伝え独断で合格にせず未判定箱に置いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: The specified micrometer. I did not decide to pass it myself; it is now in the unclassified box.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Name the specified instrument and explain that you put the part in the unclassified box without passing it on your own judgment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: その扱いで結構です。…測定面を確認して私が測っても十・〇六でした。この品は不適合として隔離します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: That is the correct handling. ...I checked the measuring surfaces and measured it myself, and got 10.06 too. We will isolate this item as nonconforming.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 不適合の箱へ移します。記録には、私が測った二つの数値も残したほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 隔離を引き受け最初の測定値を記録に残すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I will move it to the nonconforming-items box. Should the record also retain both of my measurements?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Agree to isolate the part and ask whether to retain the initial measurement values in the record. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 両方を残してください。私の再測定値と、部品の番号も追記します。元の数字を合格の数値に書き換えないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: Keep both. We will add my repeat measurement and the part number too. Do not change the original figures to passing values.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 元の二つの数値は残します。部品番号はこの刻印のＡ二十四で合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 元の数値を残すと伝え刻印の部品番号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I will keep both original figures. Is the part number A24, as stamped here?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the original values and confirm the stamped part number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、Ａ二十四です。記録したら私に見せてください。同じ箱の残りも通常どおり一個ずつ検査します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, A24. Show me the record when you have written it. Inspect the rest of the same box individually as usual too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: Ａ二十四と再測定値を追記して、記録をお見せします。残りも一個ずつ測り、同じように迷ったら相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintJa: 番号と再測定値を追記して記録を提示し残品も一個ずつ検査すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I will add A24 and the repeat measurement and show you the record. I will measure the remaining parts individually too and consult you if I am similarly unsure.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Confirm you will add the number and repeat measurement, show the record, and inspect the remaining items individually. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 確認しました。隔離した部品は私から責任者に報告しますので、通常の検査へ戻ってください。では、また後ほど。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-07-001-SHARED.translation: I have checked it. I will report the isolated part to the supervisor, so please return to normal inspections. See you later.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: お席へご案内する前に、何かご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Is there something you would like to discuss before I show you to a table?

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 卵のアレルギーがあります。焼き魚定食を考えていますが、付け合わせやたれにも卵は入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 卵アレルギーを伝え焼き魚定食の付け合わせとたれの卵使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: I have an egg allergy. I am considering the grilled-fish set meal, but do its side dishes or sauce contain egg too?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Explain your egg allergy and ask whether the grilled-fish set's side dishes and sauce use egg. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 厨房に確認します。…付け合わせには卵を使ったマヨネーズがあります。たれの原材料表示には卵の記載はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: I will check with the kitchen. ...The side dish includes mayonnaise made with egg. Egg is not listed on the sauce's ingredient label.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: マヨネーズを外しても、卵を扱った器具が魚に触れることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: マヨネーズを外した場合の器具による接触を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Even if you remove the mayonnaise, could utensils that handled egg touch the fish?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Check possible contact through utensils if the mayonnaise is removed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 魚は別の焼き台で焼きますが、盛り付けの器具や作業台は共用です。卵が混じらないとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: The fish is cooked on a separate grill, but plating utensils and worktops are shared. We cannot promise there will be no egg contamination.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 共用の器具があるんですね。別の料理なら、卵の混入を避けられると確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 器具共用を理解し別料理で卵混入を避けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: So some utensils are shared. Can you confirm that a different dish would avoid egg contamination?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the shared utensils and ask whether another dish could avoid egg contamination. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: 申し訳ありません。厨房が共通なので、ほかの料理でも混入の可能性を否定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: I am sorry. The kitchen is shared, so we cannot rule out contamination in other dishes either.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: わかりました。今日は料理を注文せず、別の店を探します。まだ何も頼んでいませんが、そのまま出ても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 確認結果に基づき注文を見送り未注文で退店できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Understood. I will not order food today and will look for another restaurant. I have not ordered anything yet; is it okay to leave as I am?
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Decide not to order based on the confirmed information, and ask whether you may leave without having ordered. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: はい、まだご着席もご注文もされていないので、そのままお帰りいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Yes, you have not been seated or placed an order yet, so you can leave directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: では失礼します。材料だけでなく、器具のことも調べてくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintJa: 退店すると伝え材料と器具を確認した店員に礼を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Then I will be going. Thank you for checking not only the ingredients but the utensils too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.hintTranslation: Say you will leave and thank the staff for checking ingredients and utensils. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.sourceJa: こちらこそ、ご注文前にお知らせくださりありがとうございました。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HRS-HATSUKAICHI-08-001-SHARED.translation: Thank you for telling us before ordering. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その模型に興味がおありですか。次の実演まで、仕組みをご説明できます。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you interested in that model? I can explain how it works before the next demonstration.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい歯車を回すと、大きい歯車がゆっくり動くのはなぜですか。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい歯車と大きい歯車の回転速度が違う理由を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-02.translation: Why does the large gear move slowly when the small gear is turned?
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask why the small and large gears rotate at different speeds. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 歯の数が違うためです。小さい方が何周もする間に、大きい方が一周します。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Because they have different numbers of teeth. The large gear turns once while the small one turns several times.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 歯の数を比べたいので、模型を近くで見てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歯の数を比べるため模型を近くで見てよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-04.translation: May I look at the model close up to compare the number of teeth?
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may look at the model close up to compare its gear teeth. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、手すりの手前までどうぞ。動く部分には触れず、こちらの図もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, you may come up to this side of the handrail. Do not touch the moving parts, and please look at this diagram too.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この図と模型を一緒に写真に撮って、家で見直したいです。撮影できますか。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図と模型を一緒に撮影したいと伝え撮影の可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to photograph this diagram and the model together to review at home. Is photography allowed?
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to photograph the diagram and model together and check permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この展示は撮影できます。ただ、実演中はほかのお客様の視界を遮らない場所からお願いします。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may photograph this exhibit. During demonstrations, however, please do so from somewhere that does not block other visitors' view.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 実演を見ながら説明も聞きたいのですが、どこに立つといいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実演と説明の両方がわかる立ち位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to watch the demonstration and hear the explanation too. Where should I stand?
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask where to stand to understand both the demonstration and explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 右側の足元の印なら、模型と説明係の両方が見えます。写真は実演が終わってからでも撮れますよ。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-09.translation: From the floor mark on the right, you can see both the model and the person explaining. You can take photos after the demonstration too.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に右側で実演を見て、そのあと空いてから写真を撮ります。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 右側で実演を見たあと空いてから撮影すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will watch the demonstration from the right first, then take photos after it becomes less crowded.
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will watch from the right and photograph afterward when there is space. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それならゆっくり確かめられますね。どうぞ見学をお楽しみください。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-HRS-KURE-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will let you examine it at leisure. Please enjoy your visit. Excuse me.
